templates.why_chosen: A modest fit inside a numbered hardware-block figure: n-1 VM Queue icons plus an ellipsis plus one distinguished LM Queue icon sit inside the LM Controller, echoing the index-and-distinguish-the-last-one replication rule at small scale.
templates.what_to_learn: Even inside a single hardware block, use the ellipsis-plus-one-distinguished-instance device for a queue array (ordinary VM queues, ellipsis, one dedicated LM queue) rather than drawing every queue, and number the resulting datapaths with a small color-coded legend the way this figure numbers its four.

templates.why_chosen: Medium-confidence pick showing numbering and legend together: one LM Controller box mediates all NVMe traffic, and four colour-coded, numbered datapaths, ordinary access, double write, migration send and receive, share an inside legend.
templates.what_to_learn: When several distinct request types share one hardware block, give each its own number and colour and keep a compact legend inside a free corner near that block rather than redrawing it per path; keep the FPGA boundary as a dotted outline with the true off-chip resource drawn outside it.
